comment: Both sets of point jacks cover the inner points only, the second up to the fifteenth, PHSR2.cpp:98-99, because the first and last points are pinned to the ends of the cycle. They are monophonic, so one voltage moves that point for every voice. A jack past the current Length setting is passed over, PHSR2.cpp:168-169. The X jacks set a place between the two neighbouring points rather than an absolute position, PHSR2.cpp:178-180, so moving one point drags the range of its neighbours with it.
